title: Stateful generators: ExternalSecret and PushSecret controllers changed
quote: While normally this isn't a problem, external secrets controller and push secrets controller have been changed.
remediation: Watch the ExternalSecrets named (they use generators) for sync errors after the upgrade and report regressions upstream, as the release asks.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select([(.spec.dataFrom // .spec.externalSecretSpec.dataFrom // [])[]?.sourceRef.generatorRef] | map(select(. != null)) | length != 0) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is an ExternalSecret that uses a generator

title: PushSecret `refreshInterval` now defaults to 1h — PushSecrets without it start re-pushing hourly

detection.reason: the agent writes refreshIntervalSet on every PushSecret (false when spec.refreshInterval is absent)

quote: fix: add push secret refreshInterval defaulting
remediation: Set `spec.refreshInterval` explicitly on the PushSecrets named if hourly re-pushes are unwanted (e.g. `0` for push-once); the CRD now fills in `1h`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pushsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterpushsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select((.spec.refreshInterval // .spec.pushSecretSpec.refreshInterval // "") == "") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a PushSecret relying on the default

title: Vault userPass auth: default mount path changed from `user` to `userpass`

detection.reason: the store projection names auth methods, not whether `path` is set under them

quote: update: update Kubernetes tags for vault provider and change path default
remediation: The CRD default of `auth.userPass.path` changed from `user` to `userpass`. A live store keeps the `user` it was defaulted to when created, so check the SOURCE manifests (Git / Helm) of the stores named, and of VaultDynamicSecret generators and ClusterGenerators using userPass, for `userPass` without `path`: re-applied or recreated, they get `userpass`. Set `path: user` explicitly if the method is mounted at `user/` in Vault.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("vault")) | select(.spec.provider.vault.auth.userPass != null) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) path=\(.spec.provider.vault.auth.userPass.path // "-")"'  # each row uses userPass and the path it resolved to; compare with the source manifest
